verdict.rationale: The Devin API supports programmatic session creation (including on behalf of other users), which could be scripted to process many items in bulk, and the CLI/Ask-Devin flow can be pointed at multiple tickets, but there is no first-party documentation of a dedicated bulk/batch operation feature (e.g., processing a list of tickets or files in one command) nor any community evidence of it working at scale. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints or CLI flags, first-party examples of multi-item processing, and independent confirmation of successful large-scale parallel runs.
